thought.text: App started successfully and connected to DB. Now verify HTTP endpoints and database data.

reasoning_content:
The app started successfully. Now verify endpoints: /health, /api, /api-json, and DB data.

Note: the app config uses DB_HOST=db from compose env, but .env.dev sets localhost. Compose environment variables take precedence? Actually ConfigModule reads .env.dev and .env files. The env variables in the container environment override? ConfigModule's envFilePath loads files but process.env existing values take precedence (by default ignoreEnvVars false, so process.env wins). Actually the compose environment sets GEOSPATIAL_ANALYZER_DB_HOST=db, and process.env from container should override the file values. And it connected successfully. Good.

Now test endpoints.
